profile.headline: Software Engineer at NCCI
profile.geoLocationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Architected and implemented automated code governance using the Danger merge request analysis tool within Gitlab pipelines, improving code hygiene and review consistency enterprise-wide.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Led division-wide workshops on Gitlab CI/CD best practices, standardizing branching strategies and merge request workflows across teams.
- Modernized off cycle rates system, using Nats event-driven architecture with multi-stage processing. Eliminating the need for manual run requests.
- Contributed to GitOps v2 application by developing a Go CLI that dynamically generates yaml strategies within Gitlab CI/CD pipelines for Kubernetes deployments.
- Delivered an IT Tech Day presentation on Storybook, promoting component-driven development and standardized UI practices.
- Led front-end architecture and implementation of experience rating customer service tool, enabling real-time case tracking and improving operational visability for support teams.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
- Worked with a cross-functional team to deliver first application written in React and Node.js  with Kubernetes deployment.
- Led my team in a code repository migration from TFS to Gitlab and introduced CI/CD pipelines to stream line cross environment deployment
- Using Agile framework, I collaborated with product owners to create new features, increasing efficiency and usability across several applications
- Supported legacy Linux ETL process to ensure customer data quality

positions.title: Software Engineer Inten
positions.description:
Full stack C#, .Net developer
• Worked with small agile software development teams to rapidly release data visualization tools and updates
• Created ETL process for various engine programs.
• Responsible for database maintenance (such as creating backups, replication).
• Training coordinator for newly-hired developers.
• Thorough documentation of deliverables for internal customer use

positions.title: Full Time Student
positions.locationName: Florida Atlantic University Boca Raton, Florida
positions.description:
•	Intro to C: basic C constructs, pointers arrays, structs.					
•	Foundation of Computer Science: basics in C++, working with classes, inheritance.
•	Microprocessors: Assembly language of the MSP430 microprocessor
•	Data Structures & Algorithm Analysis: working with stacks, decks, queues, binary
        search trees, graphs, singly and doubly linked lists
•	Applied Database System: Created SQL database system to be used by web services
•      Principles of Software Engineering: Created c# Car Rental Reservation System

positions.title: Entrepreneur Web Designer
positions.description:
•	Full service development company that specializes in web design
•	Meet with clients to determine site needs.
•	Create small business web sites and small web applications utilizing PHP, CSS.
•	Design new web interfaces and site graphics.
•	Responsible for quality assurance of finished websites.

positions.title: Technology Manager
positions.description:
•	Overlook all systems being used in office.
•	Responsible for updating maintenance and ongoing usability of software packages.
•	Resolve computer software and hardware issues.
•	Facilitate training on Microsoft Office Tools such as Excel, Word and Outlook.
•	Design user-friendly interface for on-line advertisement and marketing.
•	Maintain the ongoing protection of data files and systems.

positions.title: Travel Consultant
positions.description:
•	Support clients via phone and email.
•	Organize group travel and events.
•	Arranged and assisted with international travel/ issues including passports and visas.
•	Developed knowledge and experience in all areas of operation for full-service travel Consultant.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
•	Worked closely with co-workers to analyze system requirements and provided IT solutions
•	Developed IT system specifications after evaluating client's nature and business volume
•	Solved IT issues, determined changes and recommended quality software
•	Kept up to date with new technology and researched latest information technology market trends
